title: Prompt-to-Image Diffusion vs. Deterministic HTML-to-Post
leftPoints: Garbled kerning and misspelled technical code terms
Requires paid cloud API keys and per-image credits
Cannot export multi-page PDFs or crisp 30fps MP4s
Different random output on every single run
rightPoints: Crisp OFL typography and exact monospace code blocks
Runs 100% locally via MCP with zero LLM API calls
Exports PNG, JPG, WebP, LinkedIn PDF & H.264 MP4
verdict: Use your coding agent for distillation—and tinytldr for deterministic rendering.
